limitations: Targeted visual and story-state checks, not engine/collision/physical-safety or native-sprite certification.
Exact untouched-pixel preservation after generation is not claimed.
Consent, identity disclosure, bed availability, paid wages and successful arrival still require actual scoped state checks.

findings.finding: The opaque central screen now stands directly across the doorway-to-chair sightline; only the chair back is visible above it. Side wings provide a sheltered nook, with a left-side approach around the screen toward the rear opening. This remedies v1’s exposed-seat layout at concept scale; usable clearance still requires a collision layout. Left yard retains the empty test rig in broad visual arrangement; no body, injury image or extra bed is introduced. Neither privacy furniture nor the empty stand certifies consent or test safety; v1’s hanging-mass stop/lock issue remains outside this fix.

Two separate foreground gateways now lead to respective ritual-table lanes, divided by a central low wall. Each can be approached from the common street without passing the other table. The rear water trough and secular aid-room approach remain distinct. This resolves the missing independent-access visual target, while exact clearance and levels remain unvalidated. No celebrants, joined rite or paid-aid outcome appears. Candle-tip lit/unlit ambiguity from v1 is unchanged and does not establish a ritual already performed; v2 should be preferred specifically for access.

The right room has clear wooden floor and an empty peg rail in the upper-left area; no bed frame, mattress, pillow, bedroll or replacement sleeping surface appears. Chair, personal bundle, closed tool roll and direct outward door remain. This candidate resolves the stated added-bed problem and does not invent reception capacity. Left panel retains two separate cloth samples and loom/work shelter. Original v1 pixels were not independently inspected in this pass, so exact before/after preservation is not certified. Personal bundle and wage pouch do not decide departure or prove new payment; continuity of the independent safe street return must remain in final layout.

overall: Prefer all three v2 candidates for their stated narrow targets: chair screening, separate ritual approaches and absence of added bed. Other previously recorded caveats remain.
